svg.title: Atelier Flow Couture about and contact pages desktop
svg.desc: Two editable 1440 pixel frames for the atelier story and the contact with frequently asked questions page.

text.tspan: Made slowly,
kept closely.
We make physical things for a life lived with
attention. Each edition begins with material,
not trend, and leaves room for the hand.
Our studio works in small series with wool, vegetable-tanned
leather, linen and clay. Variation is recorded as evidence
of process rather than corrected into sameness.
We begin with touch, weight and wear.
The silhouette follows what the material can hold.
Editions remain intentionally limited so attention
can stay with every seam, glaze and finished edge.
Patina and repair belong to each object.
Care guidance travels with every edition.

g.text: Wool is rested for twenty-four hours before the first cut.
A hidden stitch closes the edge without rigidity.
Mineral washes are cataloged before firing.

text.tspan: Elena translates paper studies into cloth, preserving
ease through the shoulder and movement at the hem.
Noah records each clay body and firing curve, allowing
subtle variation while holding function constant.

g.text: “We hope the work becomes more yours with time.”
Mara Vale and Theo Arden / Creative Directors
